login.title: Sign in to Caddy Panel
login.failed: Sign-in failed, please try again later
login.firstRunHint: First run: admin account, random password is printed in the panel startup log
login.welcomeHint: Sign in to manage sites, certificates and config
login.brandTagline: Sites, certificates and config changes — all visual, no Caddyfile editing required.
login.pointSitesDesc: Reverse proxy, static sites, redirects and L4 passthrough
login.pointCertDesc: ACME auto-issuance, manual upload and expiry alerts
login.pointRollbackDesc: Each deploy snapshots a version — diff and roll back in one click
login.twofaHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator, or use a recovery code

sites.title: Sites

hint.upstreams: Separate multiple upstreams with commas, e.g. 127.0.0.1:8080, 127.0.0.1:8081
hint.healthCheck: Caddy actively probes upstreams and ejects unhealthy ones
hint.basicAuth: Replaced and re-hashed (bcrypt) on every save; re-enter passwords for existing users, empty entries are ignored
hint.ipList: Comma separated, single IP or CIDR; allowlist returns 403 to everyone else
hint.rateLimit: Rate-limit by client IP; requires caddy with caddy-rate-limit plugin (included in compose build)
hint.dnsProvider: Issue certificates via DNS challenge; requires the matching caddy-dns plugin (cloudflare included in compose build)
hint.dnsTokenEnv: Credentials are never stored: enter the env var name, Caddy reads it from its own environment, e.g. CF_API_TOKEN
hint.node: The owning node is fixed at creation and cannot be changed later (re-create to move)
hint.nodeLocked: The owning node cannot be changed
hint.l4Listen: e.g. 0.0.0.0:3306 or :5353; must not clash with HTTP or other L4 sites
hint.l4Network: TCP/UDP passthrough only; TLS termination is not supported
hint.l4Upstreams: Comma-separated host:port list; raw passthrough (no HTTP processing)

required.name: Please enter the site name
required.l4Listen: Listen address is required for L4 sites
required.l4Upstreams: At least one upstream is required for L4 sites

sites.deleteConfirm: Delete this site? The domain goes offline immediately; rollback is available via version history

certificate.title: Certificate status — {{name}}
certificate.notIssued: Not issued yet (auto-issued on first HTTPS visit)
certificate.hint: Certificates are managed automatically by Caddy (ACME); data comes from Caddy's storage, management lands in M2
certificate.uploadHint: Pick the cert first, then the key; validated as a pair and applied on next deploy
certificate.uploadSuccess: Certificate uploaded; takes effect on next deploy

import.title: Import Caddyfile
import.previewHint: Paste an existing Caddyfile; recognized sites map to the model, unknown directives are kept verbatim as snippets
import.globalExtra: Unrecognized global directives (merged into the global snippet in Settings)
import.disabledHint: Imported sites are disabled; review then enable them one by one (enabling deploys)

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholder: Caddy status and recent deploys arrive with T8 (Dashboard)

config.title: Config Center
config.placeholder: Versions / diff / rollback / direct editing arrive with T6 (Config Center)

logs.title: Logs
logs.placeholder: Access/error log viewing arrives with T7 (Logs)

settings.title: Settings
settings.placeholder: System settings arrive with T6; language and theme switching already work

config.noVersions: No versions yet; site saves and direct edits are recorded automatically
config.saveConfirm: Save now? It will be validated and hot-reloaded immediately
config.rollbackSuccess: Rolled back and a new version was recorded
config.rollbackConfirm: Roll back to this version? Live config will be restored to its contentIf this version does not include the panel entry site or turns off its automatic HTTPS, the panel domain may become unreachable after rollback; recover via the server's local port.

settings.title: Settings

hint.adminUrl: Address the panel uses to reach the Caddy Admin API
hint.adminBind: Written into the rendered global block; Caddy relies on it after restart and it must be reachable from the panel
hint.nextOp: Takes effect on the next operation
hint.globalExtra: Appended verbatim into the global block; syntax is on you, the whole file is validated before saving
hint.acmeEmail: Rendered into the global block email directive for ACME account registration
hint.notifyWebhook: JSON alert pushed daily when remaining validity drops below 30 days
hint.smtpPassword: Not shown after saving; leave empty to keep the current password
hint.smtpTo: Comma separated; the email channel activates when server/port/to are all set
hint.gravatarMirror: Avatar source; switch to a mirror if gravatar.com is unreachable, empty uses gravatar.com
hint.panelPublic: Agent install command derives its ws URL from this; empty uses the startup env
hint.managedByEnv: Managed by deployment env (compose/env); edit the deployment config and restart to change
hint.deployManaged: Caddy connection and paths below are deployment-level settings shown read-only; the panel public URL is editable

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.warning: Importing replaces all sites, version history and settings, and never auto-deploys
backup.hint: After restoring, review and enable sites, or redeploy from the Config Center

tokens.title: API Tokens (open API)
tokens.hint: Call /api/v1 with Bearer auth; only hashes are stored, the plaintext is shown once at issuance; write performs everything, read is read-only; tokens cannot manage tokens
tokens.deleteConfirm: Delete this token? Clients using it stop working immediately
tokens.plainWarning: Copy it now — the plaintext is shown only once; if lost, delete and reissue

settings.smtpTestOk: Test email sent, please check the inbox
settings.webhookTestOk: Test message sent, please check the group
settings.webhookTestFailed: Failed to send webhook test message

logs.title: Logs
logs.missingHint: {{path}} not found; content appears here once access/error logs are produced
logs.truncated: File is large, showing the tail only

dashboard.caddyUnreachable: Caddy Admin API is unreachable: cannot read live config or deploy; check whether Caddy is running
dashboard.driftTitle: Config drift detected: out-of-panel changes or partial rollback; verify then roll back or redeploy

upstreams.title: Upstreams
upstreams.empty: No reverse-proxy upstreams yet; they appear here once a proxy site is created and enabled

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.emptyHint: After enabling the metrics endpoint in Settings, the panel scrapes Caddy metrics every 15s (kept 24h). If just enabled, re-save any site (or rollback/direct-edit once) to trigger a re-deploy so metrics are written into the Caddy global block.
metrics.noSeries: No data for this metric in the selected window
metrics.counterHint: Counters are cumulative; curves appear after ~15 minutes of scraping

terminal.title: Web Terminal
terminal.warning: Runs as the panel process user (not root); all sessions are audited

nodes.title: Remote Nodes

enroll.nodeNameHint: The node registers under this name; immutable after enrollment
enroll.plainTokenHint: Shown only once; invalidated after use — use it in the install command now
enroll.installHint: Paste on the target host (Linux + systemd) to enroll. Prerequisite: set the panel public URL (panel_public_url) in Settings

nodes.uninstallHint: Run on the target host to stop and remove the agent (delete the node record in the panel separately)
nodes.deleteConfirm: Deleting revokes the node secret; the agent must re-enroll. Delete?

field.mustChange: Force password change on first sign-in
field.newPassword: Reset password (min 8 chars, empty to keep)

confirm.delete: Delete user {{name}}? Soft-deleted with audit retained; username becomes reusable
confirm.disable: Disable user {{name}}? All their sessions will be revoked immediately
confirm.reset: Reset password? Password change will be forced on next sign-in; existing sessions revoked
confirm.kick: Sign out this session? That device will need to sign in again

error.self: Cannot perform this action on the current account
error.lastAdmin: At least one active admin is required

avatar.hint: png/jpeg/webp up to 2MiB; falls back to Gravatar by email (mirror configurable)

pwd.hint: At least 8 chars and different from the current one; all devices will be signed out
pwd.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
pwd.done: Password changed, please sign in again

twofa.scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app
twofa.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code to finish binding
twofa.codes: Recovery codes (shown once, store them safely)
twofa.regenCode: Enter the current code to regenerate
twofa.disableHint: Unbinding needs the current password and code; all devices will be signed out

sessions.confirmRevoke: Sign out this device? It will need to sign in again
sessions.confirmRevokeOthers: Sign out all other devices? This one stays signed in

forced.title: Change the initial password
forced.desc: An initial password was set by the administrator; set a new one for security
